text:
Predicates:
Premiere(x, y) ::: x premiered y.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conducts(x, y) ::: x conducts y.
MusicPiece(y) ::: y is a music piece.
Composes(x, y) ::: x writes y.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Premises:
MusicPiece(symphony9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
Composes(beethoven, symphony9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premiere(viennaMusicSociety, symphony9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Leads(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
Orchestras(x) → ∀x (∃y (Conducts(x, y))) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
∃x (Orchestra(x) ∧ ∃y (Premiere(x, y))) ::: Some orchestras premiered music pieces.
